tools.name: create_openings_from_clash
tools.description: Place and punch opening voids where linked or local MEP solid-intersects a selected wall/floor/beam/column/roof. Nearby same-host hits combine into one larger opening when leftover web cannot act as a pier. Uses LoadingAI_Opening_Horizontal_Rectangle or _Circle (walls/beams/columns) and LoadingAI_Opening_Vertical_Rectangle or _Circle (floors/roofs). Four .rfa next to the plugin; auto LoadFamily. Call immediately; do not ask to bind links. Pass hostIds or select a host — a section box is not a host. Result lists instance ids and XYZ; isolate those plus the host.

tools.name: cut_hosts_by_openings
tools.description: Repair cut of local hosts with opening voids after a family reload. Linked hosts are skipped, not cut.
